```{r}
#logistic reg for prevalence, establishment size, product type, and month as variables
#prep work
prevalence_data <- read.csv("poultryparts_38968.csv", header=TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    screening          = ifelse(salmonella_sp_analysis == "Positive", 1, 0),
    month              = factor(format(as.Date(collection_date), "%m"),
                                levels = sprintf("%02d", 1:12),
                                labels = month.abb),
    establishment_size  = factor(establishment_size,
                                 levels = c("Large","Small","Very Small")),
    product_type        = factor(product_type)
  )

#assign reference variables
prevalence_data$establishment_size <- relevel(prevalence_data$establishment_size, ref = "Large")
prevalence_data$product_type       <- relevel(prevalence_data$product_type,       ref = "Leg")
prevalence_data$month              <- relevel(prevalence_data$month,              ref = "Jan")

#logistic regression models
m_size_prevalence    <- glm(screening ~ establishment_size, data = prevalence_data, family = binomial)
m_prodtype_prevalence <- glm(screening ~ product_type,      data = prevalence_data, family = binomial)
m_month_prevalence   <- glm(screening ~ month,              data = prevalence_data, family = binomial)

#OR tables
make_or_table <- function(m) {
  data.frame(
    OR    = round(exp(coef(m)), 2),
    SE    = round(summary(m)$coefficients[, 2], 2),
    CI_lo = round(exp(confint.default(m)[, 1]), 2),
    CI_hi = round(exp(confint.default(m)[, 2]), 2),
    p     = round(summary(m)$coefficients[, 4], 4)
  )
}

m_size_prevalence_or_table    <- make_or_table(m_size_prevalence)
m_prodtype_prevalence_or_table <- make_or_table(m_prodtype_prevalence)
m_month_prevalence_or_table   <- make_or_table(m_month_prevalence)

print(m_size_prevalence_or_table)
print(m_prodtype_prevalence_or_table)
print(m_month_prevalence_or_table)
```

```{r}
#logistic reg for level, establishment size, product type, and month as variables
#prep work
level_data <- read.csv("poultryparts_38682.csv", header=TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    collection_date = as.Date(collection_date),

    # define high-level contamination
    high_contamination = case_when(
      salmonella_sp_analysis == "Negative" ~ 0,
      salmonella_quantitative_cfu_ml == "<10" ~ 0,
      !is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(salmonella_quantitative_cfu_ml))) &
        suppressWarnings(as.numeric(salmonella_quantitative_cfu_ml)) >= 10 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0  
    ),
    
    month = factor(month(collection_date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
                   levels = c("January","February","March","April","May","June",
                              "July","August","September","October","November","December"), 
                   ordered = FALSE),
    establishment_size = factor(establishment_size, levels = c("Large","Small","Very Small")),
    product_type = factor(product_type, levels = c("Breast","Leg","Wing"))
  )

#assign reference variables
level_data$establishment_size <- relevel(level_data$establishment_size, ref = "Very Small")
level_data$product_type       <- relevel(level_data$product_type,       ref = "Leg")
level_data$month              <- relevel(level_data$month,              ref = "June")

#logistic regression models
m_size_level  <- glm(high_contamination ~ establishment_size, data = level_data, family = binomial)
m_prod_level  <- glm(high_contamination ~ product_type,       data = level_data, family = binomial)
m_month_level <- glm(high_contamination ~ month,              data = level_data, family = binomial)

#OR tables
make_or_table <- function(m) {
  data.frame(
    OR    = round(exp(coef(m)), 2),
    SE    = round(summary(m)$coefficients[, 2], 2),
    CI_lo = round(exp(confint.default(m)[, 1]), 2),
    CI_hi = round(exp(confint.default(m)[, 2]), 2),
    p     = round(summary(m)$coefficients[, 4], 4)
  )
}

m_size_level_or_table    <- make_or_table(m_size_level)
m_prodtype_level_or_table <- make_or_table(m_prod_level)
m_month_level_or_table   <- make_or_table(m_month_level)

print(m_size_level_or_table)
print(m_prodtype_level_or_table)
print(m_month_level_or_table)
```

```{r}
#serotypes and levels analysis

df <- read.csv("poultryparts_38682.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

#define virulence classifications
high_virulence <- c(
  "Enteritidis",
  "Typhimurium",
  "Hadar",
  "I 4,[5],12:i:-",
  "Newport",
  "Litchfield",
  "Dublin",
  "Muenchen"
)

low_virulence <- c(
  "Infantis",
  "Kentucky",
  "Schwarzengrund",
  "Alachua",
  "Thompson",
  "Braenderup",
  "Heidelberg",
  "Typhimurium - Possible Vaccine Strain",
  "Anatum",
  "Cerro",
  "Johannesburg",
  "Mbandaka",
  "Senftenberg",
  "Montevideo",
  "Oranienburg",
  "Uganda"
)

#serotypes w/o virulence data reported in risk assessment are excluded from statistical testing
exclude_from_analysis <- c(
  "I -:r:1,5",
  "IIIa [1],13,23:g,z51:-",
  "I 7:-:1,5",
  "Barranquilla",
  "Derby",
  "Havana",
  "Indiana",
  "Liverpool",
  "Orion",
  "Widemarsh"
)

#positive samples w/o serotype data
no_serotype_strings <- c(
  "NA",
  "",
  "NULL",
  "No serotype data available",                     
  "Final result - characterization not available"
)

df_analysis <- df %>%
  filter(salmonella_sp_analysis == "Positive") %>%
  filter(
    is.na(salmonella_serotype1) |
      !(salmonella_serotype1 %in% exclude_from_analysis)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    #high-level vs. low-level Salmonella
    high_level = case_when(
      salmonella_quantitative_cfu_ml != "<10"                      ~ 1L,
      salmonella_quantitative_cfu_ml == "<10"                      ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                          ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    virulence_group = case_when(
      salmonella_serotype1 %in% high_virulence                          ~ "High-virulence",
      salmonella_serotype1 %in% low_virulence                           ~ "Low-virulence",
      is.na(salmonella_serotype1) |
        salmonella_serotype1 %in% no_serotype_strings                   ~ "No-Serotype",
      TRUE                                                               ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(virulence_group), !is.na(high_level)) %>%
  mutate(
    virulence_group = factor(virulence_group,
                             levels = c("Low-virulence", "High-virulence", "No-Serotype"))
  )

#summary table
summary_tbl <- df_analysis %>%
  group_by(virulence_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total  = n(),
    n_low    = sum(high_level == 0),
    n_high   = sum(high_level == 1),
    pct_high = round(n_high / n_total * 100, 2),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

#contingency table
contingency_3x2 <- df_analysis %>%
  group_by(virulence_group) %>%
  summarise(
    `Low-level`  = sum(high_level == 0),
    `High-level` = sum(high_level == 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("virulence_group") %>%
  as.matrix()

#Bonferroni-corrected alpha
bonferroni_alpha <- 0.05 / 3

#pairwise comparisons with Bonferroni correction
pairs <- list(
  c("High-virulence", "Low-virulence"),
  c("High-virulence", "No-Serotype"),
  c("Low-virulence",  "No-Serotype")
)

for (pair in pairs) {

  grp1 <- pair[1]
  grp2 <- pair[2]

  tbl_pair <- contingency_3x2[c(grp1, grp2), ]

  chisq_pair <- chisq.test(tbl_pair, correct = FALSE)

  rate1 <- round(tbl_pair[grp1, "High-level"] / sum(tbl_pair[grp1, ]) * 100, 2)
  rate2 <- round(tbl_pair[grp2, "High-level"] / sum(tbl_pair[grp2, ]) * 100, 2)

  # One-sided p: divide two-sided p by 2 if observed direction matches
  # (first group has higher proportion than second)
  grp1_is_higher <- rate1 > rate2
  p_one_sided    <- if (grp1_is_higher) chisq_pair$p.value / 2 else 1 - chisq_pair$p.value / 2

  sig_label <- ifelse(chisq_pair$p.value < bonferroni_alpha,
                      "*** Significant after Bonferroni correction",
                      "ns  Not significant after Bonferroni correction")

  cat(sprintf("\n--- %s vs. %s ---\n", grp1, grp2))
  cat(sprintf("  High-level rate:  %s = %.2f%%,  %s = %.2f%%\n",
              grp1, rate1, grp2, rate2))
  cat(sprintf("  X2    = %.4f\n",  chisq_pair$statistic))
  cat(sprintf("  df    = %d\n",    chisq_pair$parameter))
  cat(sprintf("  p (two-sided, raw)        = %.6f\n", chisq_pair$p.value))
  cat(sprintf("  p (two-sided, Bonferroni) = %.6f\n", min(chisq_pair$p.value * 3, 1)))
  cat(sprintf("  p (one-sided, raw)        = %.6f  [%s > %s: %s]\n",
              p_one_sided, grp1, grp2, grp1_is_higher))
  cat(sprintf("  %s\n", sig_label))
}

cat("\n")

#log reg for odds of high level contamination
df_analysis <- df_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    virulence_group = relevel(virulence_group, ref = "No-Serotype")
  )

logit_model <- glm(
  high_level ~ virulence_group,
  data   = df_analysis,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

#log reg results
or_table <- data.frame(
  OR         = exp(coef(logit_model)),
  CI_lower   = exp(confint(logit_model)[, 1]),
  CI_upper   = exp(confint(logit_model)[, 2]),
  p_value    = coef(summary(logit_model))[, 4]
)

or_table <- round(or_table, 4)
print(or_table)
```

```{r}
#linear regression for moving window categories, without NA windows
df <- read.csv("prevalencebasedresults_withoutNAcategory.csv")

run_regression <- function(data, group_label) {
  props <- data %>%
    group_by(rolling_window) %>%
    summarise(
      prop1 = mean(rw_category == 1) * 100,
      prop2 = mean(rw_category == 2) * 100,
      prop3 = mean(rw_category == 3) * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(rolling_window)

  n              <- nrow(props)
  weeks_per_year <- 52

  results <- lapply(1:3, function(cat) {
    y      <- props[[paste0("prop", cat)]]
    fit    <- lm(y ~ rolling_window, data = props)
    co     <- summary(fit)$coefficients

    slope  <- co["rolling_window", "Estimate"]  * weeks_per_year
    se     <- co["rolling_window", "Std. Error"] * weeks_per_year
    t_stat <- co["rolling_window", "t value"]
    p_val  <- co["rolling_window", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    r2     <- summary(fit)$r.squared
    t_crit <- qt(0.975, df = n - 2)
    ci_lo  <- slope - t_crit * se
    ci_hi  <- slope + t_crit * se

    direction  <- ifelse(slope >= 0, "Increasing", "Decreasing")
    p_label    <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001",
                         paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.4f", p_val)))
    trend_label <- paste0(direction, " ", abs(round(slope, 2)), " pp/year")
    annotation  <- paste0(trend_label, " | 95% CI [",
                          round(ci_lo, 2), ", ", round(ci_hi, 2), "] | ",
                          p_label, " | R\u00b2=", round(r2, 4))

    data.frame(
      establishment_size   = group_label,
      category             = paste0("Category ", cat),
      yearly_change_pp     = round(slope, 2),
      ci_lower_pp          = round(ci_lo, 2),
      ci_upper_pp          = round(ci_hi, 2),
      t_statistic          = round(t_stat, 2),
      p_value              = p_label,
      r_squared            = round(r2, 3),
      trend_label          = trend_label,   
      annotation           = annotation,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  })

  do.call(rbind, results)
}

groups <- list(
  list(label = "All Sizes",  size = NULL),
  list(label = "Large",      size = "Large"),
  list(label = "Small",      size = "Small"),
  list(label = "Very Small", size = "Very Small")
)

results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(groups, function(g) {
  sub <- if (is.null(g$size)) df else filter(df, establishment_size == g$size)
  run_regression(sub, g$label)
}))

rownames(results) <- NULL
print(results)
```

```{r}
#linear regression , pp/year, INCLUDING NA windows
data <- read.csv("prevalencebasedresults_withNAcategory.csv")

run_regression <- function(data, group_label) {
  props <- data %>%
    group_by(rolling_window) %>%
    summarise(
  n_total = n(),
  prop1   = sum(rw_category == 1,  na.rm = TRUE) / n_total * 100,
  prop2   = sum(rw_category == 2,  na.rm = TRUE) / n_total * 100,
  prop3   = sum(rw_category == 3,  na.rm = TRUE) / n_total * 100,
  propNA  = sum(is.na(rw_category))              / n_total * 100,
  .groups = "drop"
) %>%
    arrange(rolling_window)

  n              <- nrow(props)
  weeks_per_year <- 52

  results <- lapply(
    list(list(num = 1, col = "prop1"),
         list(num = 2, col = "prop2"),
         list(num = 3, col = "prop3"),
         list(num = "NA", col = "propNA")),
    function(cat) {
      y      <- props[[cat$col]]
      fit    <- lm(y ~ rolling_window, data = props)
      co     <- summary(fit)$coefficients
      slope  <- co["rolling_window", "Estimate"]   * weeks_per_year
      se     <- co["rolling_window", "Std. Error"]  * weeks_per_year
      t_stat <- co["rolling_window", "t value"]
      p_val  <- co["rolling_window", "Pr(>|t|)"]
      r2     <- summary(fit)$r.squared
      t_crit <- qt(0.975, df = n - 2)
      ci_lo  <- slope - t_crit * se
      ci_hi  <- slope + t_crit * se

      direction   <- ifelse(slope >= 0, "Increasing", "Decreasing")
      p_label     <- ifelse(p_val < 0.0001, "p < 0.0001",
                            paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.4f", p_val)))
      trend_label <- paste0(direction, " ", abs(round(slope, 2)), " pp/year")
      annotation  <- paste0(trend_label, " | ",
                            p_label, " | R\u00b2=", signif(r2, 2))

      data.frame(
        establishment_size = group_label,
        category           = paste0("Category ", cat$num),
        yearly_change_pp   = round(slope, 2),
        ci_lower_pp        = round(ci_lo, 2),
        ci_upper_pp        = round(ci_hi, 2),
        t_statistic        = round(t_stat, 2),
        p_value            = p_label,
        r_squared          = signif(r2, 2),
        trend_label        = trend_label,
        annotation         = annotation,
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
  do.call(rbind, results)
}

groups <- list(
  list(label = "All Sizes",  size = NULL),
  list(label = "Large",      size = "Large"),
  list(label = "Small",      size = "Small"),
  list(label = "Very Small", size = "Very Small")
)

results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(groups, function(g) {
  sub <- if (is.null(g$size)) data else filter(data, establishment_size == g$size)
  run_regression(sub, g$label)
}))

rownames(results) <- NULL

results <- results %>%
  mutate(category = ifelse(category == "Category NA", "NA", category))

print(results)
```

```{r}
#overall and pairwise chi-square for aggregated mw categories, excluding NA windows

categorization_chi <- read.csv("prevalencebasedresults_withoutNAcategory.csv", header=TRUE) %>%
  filter(rw_category %in% c("1", "2", "3")) %>%
  mutate(
    establishment_size = factor(establishment_size,
                                levels = c("Large", "Small", "Very Small")),
    rw_category = factor(rw_category, levels = c("1", "2", "3"))
  )

ct <- table(categorization_chi$establishment_size, categorization_chi$rw_category)
print(ct)

#row proportions
prop.table(ct, margin = 1) * 100

#overall chi-square
overall <- chisq.test(ct, correct = FALSE)
print(overall)

#standardized residuals
(ct - overall$expected) / sqrt(overall$expected)

#make pairs
sizes      <- c("Large", "Small", "Very Small")
size_pairs <- combn(sizes, 2, simplify = FALSE)

#category distribution among sizes, paired chi (Bonferroni k=3 per pair)
per_cat <- map_dfr(size_pairs, function(pair) {
  map_dfr(c(1, 2, 3), function(cat) {
    sub <- ct[pair, ]
    tbl_2x2 <- cbind(sub[, as.character(cat)],
                     rowSums(sub[, as.character(c(1,2,3)[c(1,2,3) != cat])]))
    test  <- chisq.test(tbl_2x2, correct = FALSE)
    p_bon <- min(test$p.value * 3, 1)
    res   <- (tbl_2x2 - test$expected) / sqrt(test$expected)
    tibble(
      Comparison   = paste(pair, collapse = " vs "),
      Category     = paste("Cat", cat),
      n_1          = tbl_2x2[1, 1],
      n_2          = tbl_2x2[2, 1],
      chi2         = round(test$statistic, 4),
      df           = test$parameter,
      p_raw        = test$p.value,
      p_bonf       = p_bon,
      Std_Res_grp1 = round(res[1, 1], 3),
      Std_Res_grp2 = round(res[2, 1], 3),
      Sig          = case_when(p_bon < 0.001 ~ "***", p_bon < 0.01 ~ "**",
                               p_bon < 0.05  ~ "*",   TRUE          ~ "ns")
    )
  })
})

print(per_cat)

```

```{r}
#overall and pairwise chi-square for aggregated mw categories, including NA and including NA converted to categories
run_pairwise <- function(ct, size_labels, cat_labels) {

  pairs       <- combn(seq_along(size_labels), 2, simplify = FALSE)
  k           <- length(pairs) * length(cat_labels)      
  alpha_bonf  <- 0.05 / k

  cat(sprintf("\nBonferroni correction: 0.05 / %d comparisons = %.4f\n",
              k, alpha_bonf))

  results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cat_labels), function(c_idx) {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(pairs, function(pair) {

      i <- pair[1]; j <- pair[2]

      n1     <- ct[i, c_idx];  total1 <- sum(ct[i, ])
      n2     <- ct[j, c_idx];  total2 <- sum(ct[j, ])
      tbl_2x2 <- matrix(c(n1, total1 - n1,
                           n2, total2 - n2), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)

      ft     <- fisher.test(tbl_2x2, alternative = "two.sided")
      pct1   <- round(n1 / total1 * 100, 1)
      pct2   <- round(n2 / total2 * 100, 1)
      p_val  <- ft$p.value
      p_lab  <- ifelse(p_val < 0.0001, "p < 0.0001",
                       paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.4f", p_val)))
      sig    <- ifelse(p_val < alpha_bonf, "***", "ns")

      data.frame(
        category   = cat_labels[c_idx],
        size_1     = size_labels[i],
        size_2     = size_labels[j],
        pct_size1  = pct1,
        pct_size2  = pct2,
        OR         = round(ft$estimate, 3),
        p_value    = p_lab,
        significant = sig,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }))
  }))

  rownames(results) <- NULL
  results
}

#including NA windows
data_na <- read.csv("prevalencebasedresults_withNAcategory.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

data_na <- data_na %>%
  mutate(cat_label = ifelse(is.na(rw_category), "NA",
                            as.character(as.integer(rw_category))))

size_levels <- c("Large", "Small", "Very Small")
cat_levels_na <- c("1", "2", "3", "NA")

ct_na <- table(
  factor(data_na$establishment_size, levels = size_levels),
  factor(data_na$cat_label,          levels = cat_levels_na)
)

cat("\nContingency Table (row = establishment size, col = category):\n")
print(ct_na)
cat("\nRow proportions (%):\n")
print(round(prop.table(ct_na, margin = 1) * 100, 1))

cat("\n--- Overall Chi-Square Test ---\n")
chi_na <- chisq.test(ct_na, correct = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("  X²  = %.2f\n",   chi_na$statistic))
cat(sprintf("  df  = %d\n",     chi_na$parameter))
cat(sprintf("  p   = %.2e\n\n", chi_na$p.value))

cat("--- Pairwise Fisher's Exact Tests (Bonferroni-corrected) ---\n")
pw_na <- run_pairwise(as.matrix(ct_na), size_levels, cat_levels_na)
print(pw_na)

cat("\nContingency Table (row = establishment size, col = category):\n")

cat("\n--- Overall Chi-Square Test ---\n")

cat(sprintf("  X²  = %.2f\n",   chi_conv$statistic))
cat(sprintf("  df  = %d\n",     chi_conv$parameter))
cat(sprintf("  p   = %.2e\n\n", chi_conv$p.value))

cat("--- Pairwise Fisher's Exact Tests (Bonferroni-corrected) ---\n")
pw_conv <- run_pairwise(as.matrix(ct_conv), size_levels, cat_levels_conv)
print(pw_conv)
```
